findings.description: Brambilla 2009 (PMID 19088162) tagged [4, mechanism_review] but is an original primary research study (diurnal variation measured in human subjects, JCEM 2009) — more accurately tagged cohort or open_label. Does not affect numerical claims but is a tag-discipline imprecision.

spot_checks.key_values_verified: 264-916 ng/dL (9.2-31.8 nmol/L); 9054 men; 4 cohorts (Framingham, EMAS, MrOS, SIBLOS); 5th pct=303 ng/dL; median=531 ng/dL — all confirmed
Diagnostic framework: fasting morning samples, repeated measurement, symptom requirement — all confirmed. No single numerical cutoff; emphasis on consistent low + symptoms confirmed.

Endocrine Society position statement on testosterone measurement limitations confirmed. 1133-laboratory figure is a widely attributed finding from this source; not independently confirmed from abstract alone but PMID and attribution are correct.

summary: Section B is accurate and well-sourced. The harmonized 264–916 ng/dL range is correctly attributed to Travison 2017 [cohort], the ~300 ng/dL threshold caveats (continuum, ≥2 fasting AM samples, symptoms) are correctly attributed to Bhasin 2018 [regulatory], all unit conversions are arithmetically correct, and both mandatory PMIDs were spot-checked and confirmed. One minor tag-discipline issue: Brambilla 2009 is tagged mechanism_review but is a primary human study (cohort/open_label is more precise).
